verdict.rationale: Poly's first-party docs describe a built-in Poly agent that accepts delegated work. It handles multi-step tasks spanning reading, searching, writing and organizing in one request, and it can create and edit files directly in storage. It can also summarize, explain and automate jobs like organizing a folder, and spawn and track subagents. A runtime probe confirms the docs index covers the built-in file agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the built-in agent completes delegated tasks reliably.
